title: Top gap and sub-card chat column

message.text: Taken: a Sonnet minion is removing the empty gap above the detail page and giving sub-cards the same layout as their parent. On the chat placement, I'd choose option B and change nothing yet. Option A keeps a chat column per page, which is what you have now: it sits beside its own page, but with five columns it ends up narrow and tall. Option B is one chat in a right sidebar that switches to whichever card or sub-card you have open. It gets a wide, stable chat and frees the middle columns. The cost is that a chat is no longer physically next to its own page.

Landed, live and uncommitted: the empty band above the detail page is gone. It was a 32 to 48px top margin the page's flow spacing puts on every child, and it scales up on sub-cards, which is why it looked doubled there. The fix zeroes the margin on the card page's direct children. The minion's report was cut off after that, so glance at a sub-card to confirm it also uses the parent's layout. The chat placement (3) is unchanged, as you asked.
